nodes.label: Adrenochrome
nodes.description: A chemical compound (C9H9NO3) formed by the oxidation of Epinephrine. An aminochrome with redox cycling capacity that generates ROS.

nodes.label: Epinephrine
nodes.description: Adrenaline, a catecholamine hormone and neurotransmitter; the direct precursor of Adrenochrome via oxidation.

nodes.label: Oxidative Stress
nodes.description: An imbalance between ROS production and antioxidant defenses; the primary context for adrenochrome formation.

nodes.label: Redox Cycling
nodes.description: A process where adrenochrome is repeatedly reduced and re-oxidized, catalytically generating superoxide and amplifying oxidative stress.

nodes.label: COMT
nodes.description: Catechol-O-methyltransferase; an enzyme that methylates catecholamines, competing with the adrenochrome pathway.

nodes.label: MAO
nodes.description: Monoamine oxidase; enzyme that deaminates catecholamines, competing with the adrenochrome pathway.

nodes.label: Superoxide Anion
nodes.description: O2-•, a primary ROS; both drives epinephrine oxidation and is regenerated by adrenochrome redox cycling.

nodes.label: Cardiotoxicity
nodes.description: Heart muscle damage; a major pathological consequence of adrenochrome formation via redox cycling, coronary constriction, and arrhythmias.

nodes.label: Adrenaline Catabolism
nodes.description: The metabolic breakdown of epinephrine via COMT, MAO, and the oxidative cyclization (adrenochrome) pathway.

nodes.label: Adrenaline-quinone
nodes.description: A highly reactive electrophilic o-quinone intermediate formed by two-electron oxidation of epinephrine; rapidly cyclizes to leuco-adrenochrome.

nodes.label: Leuco-adrenochrome
nodes.description: The reduced colorless intermediate (C9H11NO3) between adrenaline-quinone and adrenochrome; a redox-sensitive hydroquinone.

nodes.label: Adrenolutin
nodes.description: A fluorescent rearrangement product of adrenochrome (3,5,6-trihydroxy-1-methylindole); used as a biomarker for catecholamine oxidation.

nodes.label: Aminochromes
nodes.description: A class of molecules derived from catecholamine oxidation, characterized by an indoline-quinone core; includes adrenochrome, dopaminochrome, and dopachrome.

nodes.label: Carbazochrome
nodes.description: A stabilized semicarbazone derivative of adrenochrome; used clinically as a hemostatic agent and experimentally as a mitohormetic trigger.

nodes.label: Myeloperoxidase Pathway
nodes.description: Neutrophil enzymatic pathway where MPO uses H2O2 to produce HOCl, a potent oxidant that efficiently converts epinephrine to adrenochrome.

nodes.label: Myeloperoxidase
nodes.description: A heme-containing peroxidase in neutrophils that generates HOCl; a key enzymatic catalyst of adrenochrome formation.

nodes.label: Neutrophils
nodes.description: Immune cells that produce MPO and ROS during inflammation; a major cellular site of adrenochrome production.

nodes.label: Hydrogen Peroxide
nodes.description: H2O2, a ROS that serves as co-substrate for MPO and precursor to hydroxyl radical via Fenton chemistry; involved in adrenochrome formation.

nodes.label: Hydroxyl Radical
nodes.description: •OH, the most reactive ROS; drives epinephrine oxidation and adrenochrome formation in environments with high oxidative stress.

nodes.label: o-quinone
nodes.description: An ortho-quinone derived from catechol oxidation; a highly reactive electrophilic intermediate in the adrenochrome pathway.

nodes.label: Mitohormetic Redox-Relay
nodes.description: MRR; a strategy using controlled low-amplitude oxidative pulses from carbazochrome to trigger adaptive mitochondrial stress responses.

nodes.label: Adrenochrome Hypothesis
nodes.description: A 1950s theory by Hoffer and Osmond proposing that endogenous adrenochrome causes schizophrenia; superseded by the dopamine hypothesis.

nodes.label: Dopamine Hypothesis
nodes.description: The model attributing schizophrenia symptoms to hyperactive dopaminergic signaling; superseded the adrenochrome hypothesis.

nodes.label: Adrenochromatization
nodes.description: The process of elevating systemic/local adrenochrome levels by controlled administration or stress-induced endogenous production; a redox event.

nodes.label: Mitohormesis
nodes.description: Adaptive mitochondrial stress response where low-level ROS triggers protective pathways including antioxidant defense and mitochondrial biogenesis.

nodes.label: Adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine
nodes.description: A stabilized adrenochrome derivative formed with aminoguanidine; a glyco-oxidative modulator with AGE inhibition and hormetic properties.

nodes.label: Adrenochrome Pathway
nodes.description: The metabolic route from epinephrine oxidation through adrenaline-quinone, leuco-adrenochrome, to adrenochrome and adrenolutin.

nodes.label: Adrenochrome Semiquinone Radical
nodes.description: A transient free radical intermediate formed during redox cycling of adrenochrome; reacts with O2 to regenerate adrenochrome and produce superoxide.

nodes.label: Adrenochrome sulfonate
nodes.description: A degradation product formed from adrenochrome and bisulfite antioxidants under light; an impurity marker in epinephrine formulations.

nodes.label: Autoxidation
nodes.description: Oxidation in the presence of oxygen; the primary degradation pathway for epinephrine leading to adrenochrome and melanin formation.

nodes.label: Polymerization
nodes.description: The process by which adrenochrome and related intermediates form melanin-like pigments leading to neuromelanin accumulation.

nodes.label: Melanins
nodes.description: Broad group of natural pigments formed from adrenochrome polymerization; includes neuromelanin, eumelanin, and pheomelanin.

nodes.label: Dopamine
nodes.description: A catecholamine neurotransmitter; precursor to dopaminochrome and neuromelanin; related to the adrenochrome pathway through shared aminochrome chemistry.

nodes.label: Dopaquinone
nodes.description: An ortho-quinone from L-DOPA oxidation by tyrosinase; a branch-point intermediate in melanogenesis and the aminochrome pathway.

nodes.label: Dopachrome
nodes.description: An indole-quinone intermediate from dopaquinone cyclization; the dopaminergic analog of adrenochrome in melanin biosynthesis.

nodes.label: Inflammation
nodes.description: An immune response that creates oxidative conditions favoring adrenochrome formation via neutrophil MPO activity.

nodes.label: Myocardial Infarction
nodes.description: Heart attack; a condition where adrenochrome contributes via coronary vasoconstriction, redox cycling injury, and proarrhythmic effects.

nodes.label: Parkinson's Disease
nodes.description: Neurodegenerative disorder linked to dopamine/aminochrome oxidation in the substantia nigra; related to neuromelanin and the aminochrome pathway.

nodes.label: Schizophrenia
nodes.description: A psychiatric disorder historically linked to the adrenochrome hypothesis; now primarily explained by the dopamine hypothesis.

nodes.label: Glutathione
nodes.description: A major cellular antioxidant that reduces adrenaline-quinone back to epinephrine; depletion shifts flux toward adrenochrome formation.

nodes.label: Ascorbic Acid
nodes.description: Vitamin C; reduces adrenochrome semiquinone radical back to epinephrine; deficiency promotes adrenochrome accumulation.

nodes.label: Neuromelanin
nodes.description: A dark pigment in catecholaminergic neurons formed from adrenochrome/dopachrome polymerization; accumulates with age in the substantia nigra.

nodes.label: Indoline
nodes.description: A heterocyclic core structure of aminochromes including adrenochrome; formed by cyclization of the catecholamine side chain.

nodes.label: Methylene Blue
nodes.description: A therapeutic agent used as an electron shunt in the MRR strategy; bypasses damaged ETC complexes and buffers ROS amplitude.

nodes.label: NAD+
nodes.description: Nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide; a key cofactor for sirtuins and PARPs; NAD+ precursors fuel the MRR strategy.

nodes.label: NRF2
nodes.description: A transcription factor that activates antioxidant response elements; a key target of mitohormetic redox signaling.

nodes.label: PGC1-α
nodes.description: Peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gamma coactivator 1-alpha; a master regulator of mitochondrial biogenesis.

nodes.label: SIRT1
nodes.description: NAD+-dependent deacetylase that activates PGC1-α; a key mediator of the mitohormetic response.

nodes.label: AMPK
nodes.description: AMP-activated protein kinase; energy sensor activated by mitochondrial stress; part of the MRR signaling cascade.

nodes.label: Mitochondria
nodes.description: Cellular organelles targeted by MRR; site of adrenochrome redox cycling and superoxide generation.

nodes.label: Reactive Oxygen Species
nodes.description: ROS; reactive molecules including superoxide, H2O2, and hydroxyl radical that drive and result from adrenochrome chemistry.

nodes.label: Nitric Oxide
nodes.description: NO; a signaling molecule consumed by superoxide from adrenochrome redox cycling, leading to endothelial dysfunction.

nodes.label: Diaphorase
nodes.description: NADH-dependent cytochrome b5 reductase that reduces methemoglobin to hemoglobin; reduces adrenochrome in erythrocytes.

nodes.label: Erythrocytes
nodes.description: Red blood cells; contain hemoglobin that can oxidize epinephrine; subject to oxidative stress from adrenochrome.

nodes.label: Hemoglobin
nodes.description: Oxygen-carrying protein in erythrocytes; can oxidize epinephrine and be oxidized to methemoglobin by adrenochrome-related ROS.

nodes.label: Methemoglobin
nodes.description: Oxidized hemoglobin (Fe3+) that cannot bind oxygen; formed by ROS from adrenochrome cycling; reduced by diaphorase.

nodes.label: Methemoglobinemia
nodes.description: A condition of elevated methemoglobin causing cyanosis; linked to adrenochrome-induced oxidative stress and diaphorase deficiency.

nodes.label: Substantia Nigra
nodes.description: Brain region with dopaminergic neurons that accumulate neuromelanin from catecholamine oxidation; vulnerable in Parkinson's disease.

nodes.label: Ischemia-reperfusion Injury
nodes.description: Tissue damage from restored blood flow after ischemia; adrenochrome amplifies the oxidative burst during reperfusion.

nodes.label: Abram Hoffer
nodes.description: Psychiatrist who proposed the Adrenochrome Hypothesis of schizophrenia with Humphry Osmond.

nodes.label: Humphry Osmond
nodes.description: Psychiatrist who co-proposed the Adrenochrome Hypothesis of schizophrenia with Abram Hoffer.

nodes.label: Coronary artery constriction
nodes.description: Vasospasm of coronary arteries caused by adrenochrome via superoxide-mediated nitric oxide consumption.

nodes.label: Arrhythmias
nodes.description: Heart rhythm disturbances caused by adrenochrome via IKr inhibition and action potential prolongation.

nodes.label: Cell necrosis
nodes.description: Uncontrolled cell death triggered by high adrenochrome concentrations through redox cycling and ATP depletion.

nodes.label: NQO1
nodes.description: NAD(P)H:quinone oxidoreductase 1; two-electron reductase that competes with redox cycling by reducing quinones to hydroquinones.

nodes.label: Lungs
nodes.description: Site of adrenochrome formation during inflammation or ARDS; target of redox cycling damage.

nodes.label: Catecholamines
nodes.description: Class of hormones/neurotransmitters including epinephrine, norepinephrine, and dopamine; substrates for oxidation to aminochromes.

nodes.label: Norepinephrine
nodes.description: A catecholamine neurotransmitter; also oxidized to aminochrome derivatives in the adrenochrome pathway.

nodes.label: Septic Shock
nodes.description: A condition of massive catecholamine release with systemic inflammation driving adrenochrome generation; correlates with severity.

nodes.label: Preeclampsia
nodes.description: Pregnancy complication where placental oxidative stress drives adrenochrome formation and microvascular injury.

nodes.label: Advanced Glycation End Products
nodes.description: AGEs; cross-linked protein/lipid adducts formed by glycation; target of the aminoguanidine moiety in adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine.

nodes.label: Glyco-Oxidative Proteostasis Shield
nodes.description: GOPS; a strategy using adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine to simultaneously inhibit AGEs and induce hormetic proteostasis.

nodes.label: Mitochondrial Complex I
nodes.description: NADH:ubiquinone oxidoreductase; reduces adrenochrome to semiquinone radical initiating redox cycling.

nodes.label: Mitochondrial Complex III
nodes.description: Ubiquinol:cytochrome c oxidoreductase; generates superoxide during MRR from carbazochrome redox cycling.

nodes.label: SOD2
nodes.description: Mn-superoxide dismutase in the mitochondrial matrix; dismutates superoxide from adrenochrome cycling to H2O2.

nodes.label: Keap1
nodes.description: Kelch-like ECH-associated protein 1; sensor modified by H2O2/semiquinones that releases NRF2 for antioxidant response.

nodes.label: ATF4
nodes.description: Activating transcription factor 4; drives expression of mitokines FGF21 and GDF15 in the integrated stress response.

nodes.label: FGF21
nodes.description: Fibroblast growth factor 21; a mitokine secreted during mitochondrial stress; induces fatty acid oxidation and ketogenesis.

nodes.label: GDF15
nodes.description: Growth differentiation factor 15; a mitokine signaling through GFRAL to regulate appetite and energy expenditure.

nodes.label: Mitophagy
nodes.description: Selective autophagy of mitochondria; induced by urolithin A as part of the MRR cleanup phase.

nodes.label: Urolithin A
nodes.description: A gut microbiota-derived metabolite of ellagitannins; induces mitophagy in the MRR strategy.

nodes.label: Aminoguanidine
nodes.description: A compound that stabilizes adrenochrome to form adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine; inhibits AGE formation.

nodes.label: Hemostatics
nodes.description: Agents that stop bleeding; carbazochrome and adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine are used as hemostatic agents.

nodes.label: NADH
nodes.description: Reduced nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide; electron donor for diaphorase and mitochondrial complex I; fuels redox cycling.

nodes.label: Neuromelanin
nodes.description: Dark pigment in catecholaminergic neurons formed from adrenochrome/dopachrome polymerization; accumulates in substantia nigra with age.

nodes.label: Dopaminochrome
nodes.description: The aminochrome derived from dopamine oxidation; shares indoline-quinone chemistry with adrenochrome.

nodes.label: Smoking
nodes.description: A risk factor that promotes adrenochrome formation by increasing systemic oxidative stress and catecholamine levels.

nodes.label: Long QT Syndrome
nodes.description: Cardiac condition characterized by prolonged QT interval; adrenochrome can produce this phenotype via IKr inhibition.

nodes.label: N-Acetylcysteine
nodes.description: A glutathione precursor; potential therapeutic scavenger for adrenochrome-related pathologies.

nodes.label: Histone H1
nodes.description: Linker histone that binds linker DNA between nucleosomes, facilitating higher-order chromatin structure

nodes.label: Histone H4
nodes.description: Core histone protein; acetylation at Lys16 (H4K16ac) is associated with active transcription

nodes.label: Histone H2A.Z
nodes.description: Histone H2A variant with specialized roles in transcriptional regulation, DNA repair, and heterochromatin boundaries

nodes.label: γ-H2AX
nodes.description: Phosphorylated form of histone variant H2AX at Ser139; canonical marker for DNA double-strand breaks

nodes.label: SIRT1
nodes.description: Mammalian NAD+-dependent protein deacetylase; central longevity regulator that deacetylates histones and transcription factors

nodes.label: SIRT6
nodes.description: Chromatin-associated sirtuin that promotes DNA repair, suppresses LINE-1 retrotransposons, and attenuates cardiac hypertrophy

nodes.label: SIRT2
nodes.description: Cytoplasmic/nuclear sirtuin that deacetylates H4K16 during G2/M and regulates HNF4α stability

nodes.label: SIRT7
nodes.description: Nucleolar sirtuin that activates RNA Polymerase I and deacetylates GATA4 to suppress cardiac hypertrophy

nodes.label: SIRT3
nodes.description: Mitochondrial sirtuin that regulates oxidative metabolism and ROS defense

nodes.label: NAD+
nodes.description: Nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide; essential co-substrate for sirtuin deacetylase activity

nodes.label: HDAC1
nodes.description: Class I histone deacetylase; relocalizes to DNA damage sites in RCM hypothesis

nodes.label: RNA Polymerase I
nodes.description: Enzyme that transcribes ribosomal RNA genes in the nucleolus; rate-limiting for ribosome biogenesis

nodes.label: Nucleolus
nodes.description: Subnuclear compartment where rDNA transcription and ribosome assembly occur

nodes.label: Ribosome Biogenesis
nodes.description: Production of ribosomes; driven by RNA Polymerase I transcription of rRNA

nodes.label: I-PpoI
nodes.description: Homing endonuclease used in ICE mouse to induce mutation-free double-strand breaks in rRNA repeats

nodes.label: Glu230
nodes.description: Conserved glutamate residue in SIRT1 N-terminal domain required for resveratrol binding

nodes.label: Resveratrol
nodes.description: Polyphenol that activates SIRT1 both directly (via Glu230) and indirectly via PDE4 inhibition

nodes.label: CREB
nodes.description: cAMP response element binding protein; transcription factor integrating cAMP, Ca2+, and growth factor signals

nodes.label: BDNF
nodes.description: Brain-derived neurotrophic factor; supports neuronal survival, synaptic plasticity, and neurogenesis

nodes.label: DAF-16
nodes.description: C. elegans FOXO transcription factor; master regulator of longevity downstream of IIS

nodes.label: FOXO
nodes.description: Forkhead box O transcription factors; downstream targets of sirtuins regulating stress resistance and metabolism

nodes.label: PGC-1α
nodes.description: Master transcriptional coactivator of mitochondrial biogenesis; activated by SIRT1 deacetylation

nodes.label: SERCA2a
nodes.description: Sarco/endoplasmic reticulum Ca2+-ATPase; deacetylated by SIRT1 at K492 restoring cardiac contractility

nodes.label: Cardiac Hypertrophy
nodes.description: Adaptive cardiomyocyte enlargement progressing to heart failure under sustained pathological stress

nodes.label: Angiotensin II
nodes.description: Peptide hormone central to renin-angiotensin system; vasoconstrictor driving inflammation and oxidative stress

nodes.label: cAMP
nodes.description: Cyclic adenosine monophosphate; intracellular second messenger linking PDE4 inhibition to sirtuin activation

nodes.label: Epac1
nodes.description: Exchange protein directly activated by cAMP; links cAMP to Ca2+ release and AMPK activation

nodes.label: PDE4
nodes.description: cAMP-specific phosphodiesterase; inhibited by resveratrol to elevate cAMP levels

nodes.label: Adiponectin
nodes.description: Adipocyte-derived hormone regulating glucose homeostasis and insulin sensitivity; controlled by SIRT1-FOXO1 axis

nodes.label: TIMP3
nodes.description: Tissue inhibitor of metalloproteinases 3; downstream effector of SIRT1 defending vascular integrity

nodes.label: Cellular Senescence
nodes.description: Permanent cell cycle arrest triggered by stressors; senescent cells secrete pro-inflammatory SASP

nodes.label: Tumor Microenvironment
nodes.description: Cellular milieu surrounding tumors influencing growth, immune evasion, and therapy response

nodes.label: David Sinclair
nodes.description: Harvard biologist; discovered SIRT1 activation by resveratrol, pioneered NAD+ rejuvenation research

nodes.label: ICE Mouse
nodes.description: Inducible Changes in Epigenome mouse model; uses I-PpoI to test RCM-driven epigenetic aging

nodes.label: Androgen Receptor
nodes.description: Steroid hormone-activated nuclear receptor; repressed by SIRT1 deacetylation at Lys630

nodes.label: HNF4α
nodes.description: Orphan nuclear receptor and master regulator of hepatocyte differentiation; stabilized by SIRT2 deacetylation

nodes.label: GATA4
nodes.description: Zinc finger transcription factor essential for cardiac development; deacetylated by SIRT7 to suppress hypertrophy

nodes.label: GATA5
nodes.description: GATA family transcription factor; induced by SIRT6 to prevent endothelial injury

nodes.label: HOXA10
nodes.description: Homeobox transcription factor regulating hematopoiesis and fertility; interacts with SIRT2

nodes.label: HIC1
nodes.description: Hypermethylated in Cancer 1; tumor suppressor that represses SIRT1 transcription in a p53 feedback loop

nodes.label: Beclin-1
nodes.description: Core autophagy initiator and scaffold of PI3K-III complex; modulated by sirtuin deacetylase network

nodes.label: GABARAPL1
nodes.description: ATG8-family ubiquitin-like protein essential for autophagosome maturation and selective autophagy

nodes.label: Nkx3.2
nodes.description: Homeobox transcription factor regulating skeletal development; repressed by SIRT6 to derepress GATA5

nodes.label: p33ING1b
nodes.description: Tumor suppressor that reads H3K4me3; inhibits SIRT1 deacetylation of p53

nodes.label: p73
nodes.description: p53 family member; deacetylated by SIRT1 suppressing its pro-apoptotic activity

nodes.label: PML
nodes.description: Promyelocytic leukemia protein; scaffolds PML nuclear bodies recruiting SIRT1 and p53

nodes.label: MEF2D
nodes.description: Myocyte-specific enhancer factor 2D; deacetylated by SIRT1 to inhibit myogenesis

nodes.label: Smad7
nodes.description: Inhibitory SMAD antagonizing TGF-β signaling; degraded after SIRT1 deacetylation

nodes.label: MyoD
nodes.description: Master myogenic transcription factor; deacetylated by SIRT1 to retard muscle differentiation

nodes.label: TRPM2
nodes.description: Calcium-permeable cation channel gated by OAADPr, a sirtuin deacetylation by-product

nodes.label: Lox-1
nodes.description: Lectin-like oxidized LDL receptor; suppressed by SIRT1 via NF-κB inhibition

nodes.label: Hes1 and Hey2
nodes.description: bHLH transcriptional repressors downstream of Notch; modulated by SIRT1

nodes.label: BCA3
nodes.description: Breast cancer associated protein; neddylated form recruits SIRT1 to repress NF-κB

nodes.label: ML385
nodes.description: Selective NRF2 inhibitor blocking its DNA-binding; used to dissect NRF2-sirtuin crosstalk

nodes.label: Heparin
nodes.description: Glycosaminoglycan anticoagulant; potentiates antithrombin III; potential bleeding risk with resveratrol

nodes.label: Warfarin
nodes.description: Oral anticoagulant inhibiting vitamin K-dependent clotting factors; interacts with resveratrol

nodes.label: CaMKKβ
nodes.description: Calcium/calmodulin-dependent kinase kinase; links cAMP/Epac1 to AMPK activation

nodes.label: Antagomirs
nodes.description: Chemically engineered oligonucleotides that silence microRNAs; used to restore SIRT1 by blocking miR-217/543/378

nodes.label: Isatuximab
nodes.description: Anti-CD38 monoclonal antibody for multiple myeloma; remodels tumor microenvironment

nodes.label: Cytochrome P450
nodes.description: Superfamily of heme-containing phase I drug metabolism enzymes; inhibited by resveratrol

nodes.label: AMPK
nodes.description: AMP-activated protein kinase; energy sensor activated by CaMKKβ downstream of cAMP/Epac1

nodes.label: NF-κB
nodes.description: Transcription factor driving inflammation; suppressed by SIRT1 deacetylation of RelA/p65

nodes.label: p53
nodes.description: Tumor suppressor; deacetylated by SIRT1 dampening apoptosis; central to HIC1-p33ING1b-PML loops

nodes.label: Autophagy
nodes.description: Cellular self-digestion process; promoted by SIRT1 and essential for longevity

nodes.label: Aging
nodes.description: Progressive decline in physiological function; driven by epigenetic drift, senescence, and mitochondrial decline

nodes.label: Caloric Restriction
nodes.description: Dietary intervention extending lifespan; activates sirtuins and NAD+ biosynthesis

nodes.label: SASP
nodes.description: Senescence-associated secretory phenotype; pro-inflammatory cytokine mixture secreted by senescent cells

nodes.label: Epigenetics and Aging
nodes.description: Progressive epigenetic changes including histone loss, altered modifications, and DNA methylation shifts during aging

nodes.label: Epigenetic Remodeling
nodes.description: Dynamic reorganization of chromatin and nuclear architecture altering gene expression without DNA sequence change

nodes.label: DNA Methylation
nodes.description: Covalent addition of methyl groups to cytosine at CpG sites; key epigenetic mark for gene silencing

nodes.label: DNAmGrimAge
nodes.description: Second-generation epigenetic clock predicting mortality risk from DNA methylation at 1030 CpG sites

nodes.label: Epigenetic Clock
nodes.description: DNA methylation-based age predictor measuring biological age vs chronological age

nodes.label: DNMT1
nodes.description: Maintenance DNA methyltransferase copying methylation patterns during DNA replication

nodes.label: DNMT3b
nodes.description: De novo DNA methyltransferase establishing methylation patterns during development

nodes.label: Histone Deacetylase
nodes.description: Enzymes removing acetyl groups from histone tails; classes I-IV zinc-dependent, class III are sirtuins

nodes.label: Histone Acetyltransferase
nodes.description: Enzymes transferring acetyl groups to histone lysines; promote open chromatin and transcriptional activation

nodes.label: Histone Variant
nodes.description: Non-canonical histone isoforms replacing core histones to alter nucleosome stability and chromatin dynamics

nodes.label: NuRD Complex
nodes.description: Nucleosome remodeling and deacetylase complex coupling ATP-dependent remodeling with HDAC activity

nodes.label: CHD4
nodes.description: Chromodomain helicase DNA-binding protein 4; catalytic ATPase subunit of NuRD complex

nodes.label: Polycomb Group Proteins
nodes.description: Chromatin regulators maintaining transcriptional repression via PRC1/PRC2 and H3K27me3 deposition

nodes.label: Yamanaka Factors
nodes.description: Oct4, Sox2, Klf4, c-Myc (OSKM); four transcription factors sufficient to reprogram somatic cells to pluripotency

nodes.label: Shinya Yamanaka
nodes.description: Nobel laureate who discovered iPSCs using the four Yamanaka factors (OSKM)

nodes.label: Kazutoshi Takahashi
nodes.description: Co-discoverer of iPSCs; first author of landmark reprogramming papers

nodes.label: Oct4
nodes.description: POU-domain transcription factor; core pluripotency regulator and Yamanaka factor

nodes.label: Sox2
nodes.description: SRY-box transcription factor 2; core pluripotency regulator and Yamanaka factor

nodes.label: Klf4
nodes.description: Krüppel-like factor 4; zinc-finger transcription factor and Yamanaka factor

nodes.label: c-Myc
nodes.description: MYC proto-oncogene transcription factor; Yamanaka factor driving proliferation and chromatin opening

nodes.label: Lin28
nodes.description: RNA-binding protein blocking let-7 microRNA maturation; alternative reprogramming factor

nodes.label: Induced Pluripotent Stem Cells
nodes.description: Somatic cells reprogrammed to pluripotency by OSKM factors; avoid embryo use

nodes.label: Partial Reprogramming
nodes.description: Transient OSKM expression reversing aging phenotypes without erasing cell identity

nodes.label: Rejuvenation
nodes.description: Reversal of age-associated decline via epigenetic resetting through partial reprogramming

nodes.label: Embryonic Stem Cells
nodes.description: Pluripotent stem cells from inner cell mass of blastocyst; gold standard for pluripotency

nodes.label: Embryonic Development
nodes.description: Process of organism formation from fertilization through gestation; shaped by epigenetic remodeling

nodes.label: Differentiation
nodes.description: Process by which cells become specialized in structure and function

nodes.label: Gastrulation
nodes.description: Early embryonic process establishing three germ layers

nodes.label: Somatic Cell Nuclear Transfer
nodes.description: Nuclear transfer technique for cloning; pioneered by John Gurdon
nodes.id: notes/epigenetics/Somatic Cell Nuclear Transfer.md/Somatic Cell Nuclear Transfer

nodes.label: Cellular Senescence
nodes.description: Irreversible cell cycle arrest; characterized by SA-β-gal, p16INK4A, SASP

nodes.label: SA-β-gal
nodes.description: Senescence-associated beta-galactosidase; widely used biomarker for senescent cells

nodes.label: p16INK4A
nodes.description: Cyclin-dependent kinase inhibitor; tumor suppressor and hallmark biomarker of cellular senescence

nodes.label: CDKN1B
nodes.description: Cyclin-dependent kinase inhibitor 1B (p27Kip1); regulates cell cycle progression

nodes.label: CDKN1C
nodes.description: Cyclin-dependent kinase inhibitor 1C (p57Kip2); regulates cell cycle and development

nodes.label: Quiescence
nodes.description: Reversible cell cycle arrest in G0 phase; distinct from senescence

nodes.label: G0 Phase
nodes.description: Quiescent cell cycle phase where cells are metabolically active but non-dividing

nodes.label: Restriction Point
nodes.description: G1 checkpoint regulating commitment to cell division

nodes.label: G1 Phase
nodes.description: First growth phase of cell cycle preceding DNA replication

nodes.label: DNA Replication
nodes.description: Process of duplicating DNA during S phase; coupled with maintenance methylation by DNMT1

nodes.label: Sodium Valproate
nodes.description: HDAC inhibitor used as epigenetic modifier; induces chromatin relaxation

nodes.label: Phenylbutyrate
nodes.description: HDAC inhibitor investigated as epigenetic modifier

nodes.label: Cyclopentenyl cytosine
nodes.description: Compound inducing cellular senescence through cell cycle disruption

nodes.label: Roscovitine
nodes.description: CDK inhibitor; induces cell cycle arrest and cellular senescence

nodes.label: Hydroxyurea
nodes.description: Ribonucleotide reductase inhibitor; induces replication stress and senescence

nodes.label: Camptothecin
nodes.description: Topoisomerase I inhibitor; induces DNA damage and senescence

nodes.label: Cyclophosphamide
nodes.description: DNA alkylating agent; chemotherapy drug inducing cellular senescence

nodes.label: Histone H3
nodes.description: Core histone protein; subject to methylation at K4, K9, K27, K36 and acetylation at K9, K56

nodes.label: NRF2
nodes.description: Master transcription factor of antioxidant response; inhibited by ML385

nodes.label: CD38
nodes.description: NAD+ glycohydrolase expressed on immune cells; depletes NAD+ in TME; target of Isatuximab

nodes.label: H3K4me3
nodes.description: Histone H3 trimethylation at lysine 4; mark of active transcription start sites

nodes.label: H3K9me3
nodes.description: Histone H3 trimethylation at lysine 9; hallmark of constitutive heterochromatin

nodes.label: H3K27me3
nodes.description: Histone H3 trimethylation at lysine 27; repressive mark deposited by PRC2

nodes.label: RCM Hypothesis
nodes.description: Hypothesis that relocalization of chromatin modifiers to DNA breaks depletes native loci, eroding the epigenome

nodes.label: ICE Mouse
nodes.description: Inducible Changes in Epigenome mouse model using I-PpoI to test RCM-driven epigenetic aging

nodes.label: Nanog
nodes.description: Homeodomain transcription factor and core guardian of pluripotency and self-renewal in ESCs and iPSCs; a 'late' marker of reprogramming and part of the Oct4-Sox2-Nanog feedback network.

nodes.label: Oct4
nodes.description: POU-domain transcription factor (POU5F1), master regulator of pluripotency and one of the four Yamanaka Factors (OSKM). Forms heterodimer with Sox2 to activate pluripotency genes.

nodes.label: Sox2
nodes.description: SOXB1 HMG-box transcription factor, Yamanaka Factor, core pluripotency regulator that forms heterodimer with Oct4 and maintains neural stem cell identity.

nodes.label: Transcription Factor
nodes.description: Proteins that bind specific DNA sequences to regulate gene expression; terminal effectors of signaling pathways that recruit chromatin remodelers and histone modifiers.

nodes.label: Pluripotency
nodes.description: The capacity of a cell to differentiate into all three germ layers; maintained by the Oct4-Sox2-Nanog core network.

nodes.label: Induced Neural Stem Cells
nodes.description: Self-renewing multipotent neural progenitor cells generated directly from somatic cells through direct lineage reprogramming, avoiding the pluripotent intermediate.
nodes.id: notes/epigenetics/Induced Neural Stem Cells.md/Induced Neural Stem Cells

nodes.label: Neural Stem Cell
nodes.description: Self-renewing multipotent progenitors that generate neurons, astrocytes, and oligodendrocytes; persist in adult SVZ and SGZ niches supporting lifelong neurogenesis.

nodes.label: Muscle Stem Cell
nodes.description: Pax7+ satellite cells that repair skeletal muscle; quiescent in homeostasis, activated by HGF and Wnt signaling upon injury.

nodes.label: Satellite Cells
nodes.description: Muscle-resident Pax7+ stem cells between sarcolemma and basement membrane; synonymous with muscle stem cells; target of rejuvenation via Yamanaka Factors.

nodes.label: Mesenchymal Stromal Cells
nodes.description: Multipotent fibroblast-like stromal cells with trilineage differentiation and immunomodulatory capacity; clinically utilized cell therapy product.

nodes.label: Progenitor Cell
nodes.description: Tissue-specific multipotent cell intermediate between stem cells and mature differentiated cells; lineage-committed but retains proliferative capacity.

nodes.label: HFF1
nodes.description: Human foreskin fibroblast cell line widely used as feeder layer and somatic source for reprogramming to iPSCs.

nodes.label: Fibroblast
nodes.description: Mesenchymal spindle-shaped cell that synthesizes ECM and collagen; most abundant connective tissue cell; drives wound healing and fibrosis when persistently activated.

nodes.label: Hepatocyte
nodes.description: Chief parenchymal cell of the liver (70-85% of mass); metabolically versatile, performs synthesis, detoxification, and storage; can re-enter cell cycle for liver regeneration.

nodes.label: Hepatocyte Growth Factor
nodes.description: Pleiotropic paracrine cytokine and sole ligand of c-Met receptor tyrosine kinase; drives proliferation, motility, morphogenesis, and survival; activates quiescent muscle stem cells.

nodes.label: c-Met
nodes.description: Receptor tyrosine kinase for HGF; drives invasive growth program; proto-oncogene frequently aberrant in cancer; target of approved inhibitors.

nodes.label: MET gene
nodes.description: Proto-oncogene encoding c-Met receptor tyrosine kinase; HGF receptor; driving invasive growth; frequently amplified in cancer.

nodes.label: Liver Regeneration
nodes.description: Process by which liver restores lost mass through proliferation of quiescent hepatocytes; driven by HGF, cytokines; recapitulates partial reprogramming features.

nodes.label: Fibrosis
nodes.description: Pathological excessive deposition of ECM components leading to scarring; driven by TGF-β-activated myofibroblasts; final common pathway of chronic organ injury.

nodes.label: Connective Tissue
nodes.description: One of four basic animal tissue types; provides structural support via ECM-rich architecture; includes fibroblasts, collagen, and ground substance.

nodes.label: Basal Lamina
nodes.description: Specialized 50-100 nm ECM layer secreted by epithelial/endothelial cells; composed of laminin, collagen IV, nidogen, perlecan; provides structural support and filtration.

nodes.label: Laminin
nodes.description: Major heterotrimeric glycoprotein of the basal lamina; mediates cell adhesion, polarization, and survival through integrin binding; essential for basement membrane assembly.

nodes.label: Actin Cytoskeleton
nodes.description: Dynamic network of actin filaments providing mechanical support, cell shape, motility; regulated by Arp2/3, formins, cofilin; remodeled during EMT.

nodes.label: Focal Adhesion
nodes.description: Large macromolecular assemblies transmitting mechanical force between ECM and cytoskeleton via integrins; mechanosensing hubs regulating migration, proliferation, and quiescence.

nodes.label: FAK Signaling
nodes.description: Integrin-dependent pathway sensing ECM properties; central kinase hub at focal adhesions controlling adhesion, survival, migration, and proliferation.

nodes.label: Contact Inhibition
nodes.description: Arrest of cell growth and migration upon cell-cell contact; enforced by Hippo pathway and cadherin junctions; lost in cancer.

nodes.label: Cadherin
nodes.description: Superfamily of calcium-dependent transmembrane proteins mediating cell-cell adhesion; link to actin cytoskeleton via catenins; regulate contact inhibition and EMT.

nodes.label: CDH2
nodes.description: Encodes N-cadherin; neural/mesenchymal cadherin upregulated during cadherin switch in EMT and cancer invasion; downregulated during MET for iPSC reprogramming.

nodes.label: Slug
nodes.description: SNAI2 zinc-finger transcription factor; principal inducer of EMT repressing E-cadherin; drives neural crest delamination and cancer metastasis.

nodes.label: Snail
nodes.description: SNAI1 zinc-finger transcription factor; core EMT driver repressing epithelial adhesion genes and activating mesenchymal programs; induced by TGF-β.

nodes.label: Zeb1
nodes.description: Zinc finger E-box-binding homeobox 1 transcription factor; drives EMT and represses pluripotency; forms double-negative feedback loop with miR-200 family.

nodes.label: Epithelial-to-Mesenchymal Transition
nodes.description: Cellular program where epithelial cells lose polarity and adhesion to become migratory mesenchymal cells; driven by Snail, Slug, Zeb1; central to development, wound healing, and cancer metastasis.

nodes.label: PODXL
nodes.description: Anti-adhesion sialomucin glycoprotein; canonical surface marker of undifferentiated ESCs and iPSCs; switched on early during reprogramming.

nodes.label: B18R
nodes.description: Vaccinia virus protein acting as soluble decoy receptor for interferon-gamma; facilitates viral immune evasion by blocking JAK-STAT signaling.

nodes.label: BIG1
nodes.description: B-cell immunoglobulin gene product 1; regulates cell signaling, membrane trafficking, and growth; linked to iNSC migration and Alzheimer's disease.

nodes.label: Isogenic Pair
nodes.description: Two cell lines genetically identical except for a single defined locus; generated by CRISPR editing of iPSCs; gold standard for causal inference in disease modeling.

nodes.label: Organoids
nodes.description: Self-organizing 3D tissue cultures from stem cells that recapitulate organ architecture and function; used for disease modeling and drug screening.

nodes.label: Disease Modeling
nodes.description: Recreating human pathology in vitro using patient-derived iPSCs and organoids; paired with CRISPR isogenic pairs for mechanistic study and drug discovery.

nodes.label: Toxicity Testing
nodes.description: Assessment of adverse biological effects of compounds; increasingly uses human iPSC-derived models for predictive, human-relevant safety screening.

nodes.label: High-Throughput Screening
nodes.description: Automated method for assaying large compound/CRISPR libraries to identify bioactive hits; cornerstone of drug discovery; identifies senolytic drugs and epigenetic modulators.

nodes.label: CRISPR
nodes.description: Genome-editing technology using Cas9 nuclease guided by sgRNA; includes CRISPRa/i, base editing, prime editing; approved therapy for sickle cell disease.

nodes.label: Tissue Engineering
nodes.description: Interdisciplinary field combining cells, scaffolds, and signals to construct or repair functional tissues; integrates iPSCs, ECM scaffolds, and bioreactor maturation.

nodes.label: Tissue Repair
nodes.description: Integrated biological response restoring tissue structure after injury through hemostasis, inflammation, proliferation, and remodeling phases.

nodes.label: Regenerative Medicine
nodes.description: Therapeutic field harnessing cell therapy, tissue engineering, and reprogramming to repair or replace damaged tissues.

nodes.label: Retinal Pigment Epithelium
nodes.description: Monolayer of pigmented cells between photoreceptors and Bruch's membrane; performs phagocytosis, visual cycle, blood-retina barrier; RPE65 gene therapy approved.

nodes.label: RB1
nodes.description: Tumor suppressor gene encoding retinoblastoma protein (pRb); gates G1/S transition by inhibiting E2F; enforces quiescence; inactivated in many cancers.

nodes.label: Ubiquitin Ligase
nodes.description: E3 ubiquitin ligases that recognize substrates and catalyze ubiquitin transfer; >600 in humans; regulate proteostasis, cell cycle, signaling; PROTAC drug target class.

nodes.label: BMP Signaling Pathway
nodes.description: Branch of TGF-β superfamily regulating bone formation, neural patterning, heart development; signals via SMAD1/5/8 and SMAD4; antagonized by Noggin.

nodes.label: TGF-beta Signaling Pathway
nodes.description: Pleiotropic cytokine system regulating proliferation, differentiation, EMT, fibrosis, and immune modulation via SMAD2/3/4; dual tumor suppressor/oncogenic driver.

nodes.label: TGF-beta Receptor
nodes.description: Transmembrane serine/threonine kinase receptors transducing TGF-β signals via SMAD proteins; regulate growth, differentiation, EMT, and immune tolerance.

nodes.label: Hippo Signaling Pathway
nodes.description: Conserved kinase cascade controlling organ size via YAP/TAZ coactivators; integrates mechanical cues, contact inhibition; dysregulated in cancer.

nodes.label: Translation
nodes.description: Ribosomal protein synthesis from mRNA; final step of gene expression; regulated by mTORC1; dysregulated in cancer and ribosomopathies.

nodes.label: Drosha
nodes.description: Nuclear RNase III enzyme forming Microprocessor complex with DGCR8; initiates miRNA biogenesis by cleaving pri-miRNA to pre-miRNA.

nodes.label: miR-217
nodes.description: Pro-senescence microRNA repressing SIRT1 by binding its 3'-UTR; drives endothelial aging and NF-κB-mediated inflammation; candidate LNA antagomir target.

nodes.label: miR-378
nodes.description: Intronic microRNA within PGC-1β gene; represses SIRT1 in aging; links mitochondrial metabolism to SIRT1-NF-κB inflammatory axis.

nodes.label: miR-543
nodes.description: Imprinted DLK1-DIO3 cluster microRNA repressing SIRT1; connects epigenetic drift to inflammatory aging; targeted by LNA antagomirs.

nodes.label: Epigenetics and aging
nodes.description: Comprehensive review of epigenetic alterations during aging including histone loss, heterochromatin reorganization, DNA methylation changes, and transposable element activation.

nodes.label: Olivopontocerebellar Atrophy
nodes.description: Neurodegenerative pattern affecting cerebellum, pontine nuclei, and inferior olives; modeled via iPSC-derived neurons for drug screening.

nodes.label: Stress-Induced Premature Senescence
nodes.description: Acute senescence triggered by subcytotoxic stressors (oxidative, genotoxic) without telomere shortening; rapid DDR-p53-p21 pathway activation.

nodes.label: Tumor-Suppressor Loss-Induced Senescence
nodes.description: Senescence program triggered by loss of tumor suppressors (PTEN, RB1, p16); intrinsic tumor-suppressive checkpoint preventing malignant progression.

nodes.label: Diaziquone
nodes.description: Aziridinylbenzoquinone alkylating agent crossing BBB; studied for brain tumors; used experimentally to induce senescence through DNA cross-linking.

nodes.label: H3K9me3
nodes.description: Repressive histone mark trimethylated at H3 lysine 9; nucleates heterochromatin via HP1; globally reduced in aging but focally enriched in SAHF.

nodes.label: Cancer
nodes.description: Disease of uncontrolled cell proliferation; involves loss of contact inhibition, EMT activation, and dysregulated signaling pathways.

nodes.label: Quiescence
nodes.description: Reversible cell cycle arrest in G0 phase; maintained by RB1 and CDK inhibitors; characteristic of adult stem cells; exit triggered by injury signals.

nodes.label: Reprogramming
nodes.description: Process of converting somatic cells to pluripotent stem cells via Yamanaka factor expression; involves MET, epigenetic reset, and metabolic shift.

nodes.label: Neurodegeneration
nodes.description: Progressive loss of neuronal structure and function; modeled via patient-specific iPSC-derived neurons; linked to aging and proteotoxic stress.

nodes.label: Autophagy
nodes.description: Evolutionarily conserved lysosomal catabolic process that degrades and recycles intracellular components to maintain cellular homeostasis

nodes.label: Macroautophagy
nodes.description: Primary autophagy type involving sequestration of cytoplasmic cargo in double-membrane autophagosomes that fuse with lysosomes

nodes.label: Microautophagy
nodes.description: Autophagy type involving direct engulfment of cytoplasmic components by the lysosomal membrane via invagination

nodes.label: Selective Autophagy
nodes.description: Receptor-mediated pathway that targets, degrades, and recycles specific cellular cargo including organelles and pathogens

nodes.label: Autophagic Lysosome Reformation (ALR)
nodes.description: Mechanism regenerating functional lysosomes from autolysosomes after autophagic cargo degradation, regulated by mTOR and PIKfyve

nodes.label: Lipophagy
nodes.description: Selective autophagy of lipid droplets within lysosomes for mobilizing fat stores in response to nutrient availability

nodes.label: Endocytic Lysosome Reformation (ELR)
nodes.description: Process regenerating lysosomes from endolysosomes via PIKfyve-mediated PtdIns(3,5)P2 production and TRPML1 activation

nodes.label: mTORC2
nodes.description: Rapamycin-insensitive multi-protein mTOR complex regulating cytoskeletal organization, cell survival, and metabolism via Akt Ser473 phosphorylation

nodes.label: ULK1
nodes.description: Serine/threonine protein kinase serving as central initiator of autophagy; mammalian ortholog of yeast Atg1

nodes.label: Beclin1
nodes.description: Key regulatory protein (Atg6/BECN1) that assembles the class III PI3K complex for autophagosome nucleation; haploinsufficient tumor suppressor

nodes.label: Atg1
nodes.description: Conserved serine/threonine kinase initiating autophagy in response to nutrient deprivation; yeast ortholog of mammalian ULK1

nodes.label: Atg4
nodes.description: Cysteine protease that processes and deconjugates Atg8/LC3 family proteins for autophagosome membrane conjugation

nodes.label: Atg5
nodes.description: Protein essential for autophagy initiation; forms Atg12-Atg5-Atg16L1 E3-like ligase complex for LC3-PE conjugation

nodes.label: Atg14
nodes.description: Metazoan-specific subunit conferring autophagosome-specific localization to class III PI3K complex I; also known as Atg14L/Barkor

nodes.label: Atg15
nodes.description: Yeast autophagy protein with predicted triglyceride lipase activity for lipid degradation in vacuole; homolog of mammalian lysosomal acid lipase

nodes.label: BEC-1
nodes.description: C. elegans ortholog of mammalian Beclin1 and yeast Atg6; key autophagy regulator in the class III PI3K complex

nodes.label: GABARAP
nodes.description: Atg8 family member involved in later stages of autophagosome maturation and fusion with lysosome

nodes.label: GATE-16
nodes.description: GABARAPL2, Atg8 family member involved in intra-Golgi transport and autophagosome formation

nodes.label: LGG-2
nodes.description: C. elegans ortholog of yeast Atg8 and mammalian GABARAP; functions in autophagosome formation and lipophagy

nodes.label: Rab7
nodes.description: Late endosome/lysosome small GTPase governing autophagosome-lysosome fusion and endolysosomal maturation

nodes.label: LAMP1
nodes.description: Major integral membrane glycoprotein of lysosome; maintains lysosomal integrity and tethers autophagosomes during fusion

nodes.label: V-ATPase
nodes.description: Multi-subunit proton pump that acidifies lysosome lumen enabling hydrolase activation and mTORC1 nutrient sensing

nodes.label: TFEB
nodes.description: Master transcription factor regulating autophagy-lysosome pathway via CLEAR element binding; coordinates lysosomal biogenesis and autophagy

nodes.label: TFE3
nodes.description: MiT/TFE family transcription factor that along with TFEB regulates lysosomal biogenesis and autophagy via CLEAR elements

nodes.label: ZKSCAN3
nodes.description: Zinc finger transcription factor acting as master repressor of autophagy and lysosome biogenesis

nodes.label: CLEAR Element
nodes.description: 10-bp E-box-like consensus motif (5'-GTCACGTGAC-3') in promoters of lysosomal and autophagic genes; binding site for TFEB and TFE3

nodes.label: CLEAR Network
nodes.description: Master transcriptional program driving coordinated expression of lysosomal and autophagy genes via TFEB/TFE3
nodes.id: notes/sirtuins/Coordinated Lysosomal Expression and Regulation.md/CLEAR Network

nodes.label: PRAS40
nodes.description: Proline-rich AKT substrate 40 kDa; intrinsic negative regulator of mTORC1 that blocks substrate binding until phosphorylated by AKT

nodes.label: Deptor
nodes.description: Endogenous inhibitor of both mTORC1 and mTORC2; binds mTOR kinase domain and blocks substrate access

nodes.label: Raptor
nodes.description: Regulatory-associated protein of mTOR; essential scaffold subunit of mTORC1 recruiting substrates via TOS motifs

nodes.label: mSIN1
nodes.description: Essential mTORC2 component maintaining complex integrity and conferring substrate specificity toward Akt and SGK1

nodes.label: SGK1
nodes.description: AGC family kinase activated by mTORC2; regulates ion transport, cell survival, and autophagy

nodes.label: FNIP1
nodes.description: Folliculin-interacting protein that with FLCN and FNIP2 forms GAP for Rag GTPases regulating mTORC1 recruitment to lysosome

nodes.label: GATOR2
nodes.description: Protein complex that negatively regulates GATOR1 to promote mTORC1 activation in presence of amino acids

nodes.label: CASTOR1
nodes.description: Arginine sensor that negatively regulates mTORC1 by sequestering GATOR2 in the absence of arginine

nodes.label: Amino Acid Sensing
nodes.description: Cellular detection of nutrient availability via V-ATPase-Ragulator-Rag-mTORC1 axis that regulates autophagy and TFEB localization

nodes.label: TSC2
nodes.description: Tuberin; forms TSC1-TSC2 complex that acts as GAP for Rheb to negatively regulate mTORC1

nodes.label: Lysosome
nodes.description: Primary degradative organelle; terminal compartment for autophagic cargo digestion and nutrient sensing hub

nodes.label: mTORC1
nodes.description: Master nutrient-sensitive kinase complex that suppresses autophagy under nutrient-rich conditions by phosphorylating ULK1 and TFEB

nodes.label: AMPK
nodes.description: Energy sensor kinase that activates autophagy under low ATP by phosphorylating ULK1

nodes.label: Autophagosome
nodes.description: Double-membrane vesicle that sequesters cytoplasmic cargo and fuses with lysosomes for degradation

nodes.label: Mitophagy
nodes.description: Selective autophagy of mitochondria for mitochondrial quality control

nodes.label: SIRT1
nodes.description: NAD+-dependent deacetylase that promotes autophagy by deacetylating ULK1, Beclin1, TFEB, and histone H4K16

nodes.label: Vps34
nodes.description: Catalytic subunit of class III PI3K complex producing phosphatidylinositol 3-phosphate for autophagosome nucleation

nodes.label: Autolysosome
nodes.description: Fusion product of autophagosome and lysosome where cargo degradation occurs

nodes.label: Aging
nodes.description: Biological aging process associated with declining autophagic flux and accumulation of cellular damage

nodes.label: Cancer
nodes.description: Disease where autophagy plays dual roles: tumor suppression in early stages and survival support in established tumors

nodes.label: Neurodegenerative Diseases
nodes.description: Diseases associated with failed autophagic clearance of protein aggregates including Alzheimer's and Parkinson's

nodes.label: SIRT2
nodes.description: Sirtuin deacetylase that promotes TFEB mRNA stability and regulates autophagy through FOXO-dependent transcription

nodes.label: Akt
nodes.description: Serine/threonine kinase that phosphorylates PRAS40 to relieve mTORC1 inhibition and phosphorylates Beclin1 to inhibit autophagy

nodes.label: Atg8
nodes.description: Ubiquitin-like protein family (LC3/GABARAP) conjugated to autophagosome membranes; central to membrane elongation

nodes.label: LC3
nodes.description: Mammalian Atg8 ortholog; lipidated LC3-II decorates autophagosomal membranes and serves as autophagy marker

nodes.label: Atg12
nodes.description: Ubiquitin-like modifier conjugated to Atg5 forming the Atg12-Atg5-Atg16L1 E3-like ligase complex

nodes.label: Atg13
nodes.description: ULK1/Atg1 complex component; bridges nutrient signals from mTORC1 to regulate autophagy initiation

nodes.label: Atg16L1
nodes.description: Component of the Atg12-Atg5-Atg16L1 E3-like ligase complex for LC3 lipidation

nodes.label: PI3K Class III
nodes.description: Lipid kinase complex producing PI3P for autophagosome nucleation; scaffolded by Beclin1

nodes.label: Spermidine
nodes.description: Autophagy-inducing polyamine that promotes eIF5A hypusination enabling TFEB translation

nodes.label: Rapamycin
nodes.description: mTOR inhibitor that induces autophagy and extends lifespan in model organisms

nodes.label: FIP200
nodes.description: Scaffold protein anchoring the ULK1 complex and linking it to autophagy substrates

nodes.label: Atg101
nodes.description: Small protein that stabilizes ULK1 by preventing its proteasomal degradation

nodes.label: Ragulator
nodes.description: Lysosomal scaffolding complex that recruits mTORC1 via Rag GTPases in response to amino acid signals

nodes.label: Rag GTPases
nodes.description: Heterodimeric GTPases that recruit mTORC1 to the lysosomal surface in response to amino acid availability

nodes.label: HOPS complex
nodes.description: Tethering complex recruited by active Rab7 that bridges SNARE complexes for autophagosome-lysosome fusion

nodes.label: PIKfyve
nodes.description: Kinase producing PtdIns(3,5)P2 required for both autophagic and endocytic lysosome reformation

nodes.label: Lysosomal Acid Lipase (LAL)
nodes.description: Enzyme mediating lysosomal lipolysis; mammalian homolog of yeast Atg15

nodes.label: Folliculin (FLCN)
nodes.description: Tumor suppressor forming complex with FNIP1/2 that acts as GAP for Rag GTPases regulating mTORC1

nodes.label: GATOR1
nodes.description: GAP complex for Rag GTPases that suppresses mTORC1; negatively regulated by GATOR2

nodes.label: Rheb
nodes.description: Ras homolog enriched in brain; small GTPase that directly activates mTORC1; target of TSC2 GAP activity

nodes.label: TSC1
nodes.description: Hamartin; forms TSC1-TSC2 complex with GAP activity toward Rheb to suppress mTORC1

nodes.label: HLH-30
nodes.description: C. elegans TFEB ortholog; transcription factor coordinating lipophagy gene expression

nodes.label: C. elegans
nodes.description: Model organism used extensively in autophagy and longevity research

nodes.label: Sestrin2
nodes.description: Leucine sensor that inhibits GATOR2 to regulate mTORC1 activation

nodes.label: p62/SQSTM1
nodes.description: Selective autophagy receptor targeting ubiquitinated cargo to autophagosomes; accumulates when autophagic flux is impaired

nodes.label: PI3K-Akt Signaling
nodes.description: Key intracellular pathway regulating survival and metabolism; activates mTORC1 and suppresses autophagy

nodes.label: Akt
nodes.description: Kinase in PI3K-Akt pathway that phosphorylates TFEB and activates mTORC1 via TSC2 inhibition and PRAS40 phosphorylation

nodes.label: TFEB
nodes.description: MiT/TFE transcription factor that regulates autophagy and lysosomal biogenesis; inhibited by Akt and ERK2 phosphorylation

nodes.label: RAS
nodes.description: Small GTPase that activates PI3K downstream of RTKs

nodes.label: PDK1
nodes.description: Kinase recruited by PIP3 that activates Akt

nodes.label: mTORC1
nodes.description: Key nutrient-sensing complex that suppresses autophagy when activated; downstream target of Akt signaling

nodes.label: TSC2
nodes.description: Tumor suppressor that inhibits mTORC1; inactivated by Akt phosphorylation

nodes.label: PRAS40
nodes.description: mTORC1 inhibitor that is phosphorylated and inactivated by Akt

nodes.label: PI3K inhibitors
nodes.description: Compounds such as Wortmannin and LY294002 that inhibit PI3K and induce autophagy

nodes.label: MAPK Signaling
nodes.description: Evolutionarily conserved three-tier kinase cascades that transduce extracellular cues into nuclear and cytoplasmic responses; key regulator of TFEB localization

nodes.label: p38 MAPK
nodes.description: Stress-activated MAPK that promotes TFEB nuclear accumulation and autophagic-lysosomal gene expression

nodes.label: ERK2
nodes.description: Growth-factor MAPK that phosphorylates TFEB at S142 to favor cytosolic retention

nodes.label: Beclin1
nodes.description: Autophagy nucleation factor released via JNK-mediated Bcl-2 phosphorylation

nodes.label: ERK Signaling
nodes.description: Major MAPK pathway regulating cell growth and differentiation; ERK2 phosphorylates TFEB at S142 promoting cytosolic retention

nodes.label: ELK1
nodes.description: Transcription factor phosphorylated by nuclear ERK

nodes.label: MYC
nodes.description: Transcription factor phosphorylated by nuclear ERK

nodes.label: FOS
nodes.description: Transcription factor phosphorylated by nuclear ERK

nodes.label: ULK1
nodes.description: Autophagy-initiating kinase; regulated by ERK signaling and nutrient availability

nodes.label: DAF-2
nodes.description: C. elegans orthologue of the insulin/IGF1 receptor; central regulator of development, metabolism, and longevity

nodes.label: C. elegans
nodes.description: Nematode model organism used extensively in aging and autophagy research

nodes.label: IGF1
nodes.description: Insulin-like growth factor 1; DAF-2 is the C. elegans orthologue of the insulin/IGF1 receptor

nodes.label: DAF-16
nodes.description: C. elegans FOXO transcription factor; primary effector of DAF-2 insulin signaling, excluded from nucleus upon DAF-2 activation

nodes.label: Lipophagy
nodes.description: Selective autophagy of lipid droplets; induced by starvation and DAF-2 inhibition

nodes.label: Lysosomal Lipolysis
nodes.description: Degradation of lipids within lysosomes by acidic lipases; downstream of lipophagy

nodes.label: MXL-3
nodes.description: C. elegans transcriptional repressor of lysosomal lipases; regulated by DAF-2 signaling

nodes.label: Longevity
nodes.description: Extended lifespan; DAF-2 hypomorphs significantly extend lifespan in an autophagy-dependent manner

nodes.label: DAF-7
nodes.description: C. elegans orthologue of TGF-beta signaling molecule; regulates dauer entry, fat metabolism, and autophagy

nodes.label: TGF-β
nodes.description: Transforming Growth Factor beta; DAF-7 is the C. elegans orthologue

nodes.label: Dauer Larva
nodes.description: Alternative developmental stage in C. elegans induced by environmental stress; regulated by DAF-7/TGF-beta signaling

nodes.label: RHEB-1
nodes.description: C. elegans orthologue of small GTPase Rheb; key activator of CeTOR/mTOR

nodes.label: Rheb
